targets.rawSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
station2 AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS entered_inspection,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value = 1) AS rejected_s2
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id = 8
      AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '7 days'
),
station3 AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS reached_processing,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value NOT BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS reprocessed,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS final_ok
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id = 16
      AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT
    'Last 7 days' AS pipeline,
    COALESCE(s2.entered_inspection, 0) AS "Entered System",
    COALESCE(s2.rejected_s2, 0) AS "Rejected at Testing",
    COALESCE(s3.reached_processing, 0) AS "Reached Processing",
    COALESCE(s3.reprocessed, 0) AS "Reprocessed",
    COALESCE(s3.final_ok, 0) AS "Final OK"
FROM station2 s2
CROSS JOIN station3 s3;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
monthly_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 8) AS total_s2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 8 AND value = 0) AS ok_s2,
        
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 17) AS total_s3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 17 AND value = 0) AS ok_s3,
        
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 16) AS total_dim,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 16 AND value BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS ok_dim
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id IN (8, 17, 16)
      AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '1 month'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * (ok_s2 + ok_s3 + ok_dim) / NULLIF(total_s2 + total_s3 + total_dim, 0), 2) AS "System Quality Yield (%)"
FROM monthly_metrics;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS "OK Parts Today",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value NOT BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS "Reprocessed Today",
    COUNT(*) AS "Total Processed Today"
FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
CROSS JOIN max_date
WHERE sensor_id = 16
  AND date >= DATE_TRUNC('day', last_now);

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
)
SELECT
    st.type AS "Station",
    ROUND(AVG(hp.value)::numeric, 3) AS "Avg Power (kW)",
    ROUND(MAX(hp.value)::numeric, 3) AS "Peak Power (kW)",
    ROUND(
        (AVG(hp.value) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(hp.date) - MIN(hp.date))) / 3600.0)::numeric,
    3) AS "Estimated Energy (kWh)"
FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
JOIN gman_sinf22.station st ON st.station_id = se.station_id
CROSS JOIN max_date md
WHERE se.type = 'Electrical'
  AND hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL ' 24 hours'
GROUP BY st.station_id, st.type
ORDER BY "Estimated Energy (kWh)" ASC;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
timeline AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        (SELECT last_now::date FROM max_date) - INTERVAL '6 days',
        (SELECT last_now::date FROM max_date),
        INTERVAL '1 day'
    )::date AS day
),
energy AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', hp.date)::date AS day,
        (AVG(hp.value) * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(hp.date) - MIN(hp.date))) / 3600.0) AS total_kwh
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE hp.sensor_id = 34
      AND hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', hp.date)::date
),
production AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('day', date)::date AS day,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS ok_parts
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id = 16
      AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '7 days'
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('day', date)::date
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(t.day, 'DD/MM') AS "Day",
    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            (e.total_kwh / NULLIF(p.ok_parts, 0))::numeric,
        4), 
    0) AS "kWh per OK Part"
FROM timeline t
LEFT JOIN energy e ON t.day = e.day
LEFT JOIN production p ON t.day = p.day
ORDER BY t.day ASC;

targets.rawSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(hp.value) AS avg_kw,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(hp.date) - MIN(hp.date))) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE hp.sensor_id = 34
      AND hp.date >= DATE_TRUNC('day', md.last_now) - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT
    ROUND((avg_kw * total_hours)::numeric, 2) AS "Energy This Week (kWh)",
    ROUND((avg_kw * total_hours * 0.1380)::numeric, 2) AS "Cost This Week (€)"
FROM metrics;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
timeline AS (
    SELECT generate_series(
        DATE_TRUNC('hour', (SELECT last_now FROM max_date)) - INTERVAL '8 hours',
        DATE_TRUNC('minute', (SELECT last_now FROM max_date)),
        INTERVAL '5 minutes'
    ) AS slot
),
active_slots AS (
    SELECT
        st.type AS station_name,
        TO_TIMESTAMP(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM hp.date) / 300) * 300) AS slot
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
    JOIN gman_sinf22.station st ON st.station_id = se.station_id
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '8 hours'
    GROUP BY st.type, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM hp.date) / 300)
)
SELECT
    t.slot AS time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.type = 'Distributing' AND a.slot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::integer AS "Distributing",
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.type = 'Testing' AND a.slot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::integer AS "Testing",
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.type = 'Processing & Validation' AND a.slot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::integer AS "Processing & Validation",
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.type = 'Transporting' AND a.slot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::integer AS "Transporting",
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.type = 'Sorting' AND a.slot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::integer AS "Sorting",
    MAX(CASE WHEN s.type = 'System-Wide' AND a.slot IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::integer AS "System-Wide"
FROM timeline t
CROSS JOIN gman_sinf22.station s
LEFT JOIN active_slots a ON t.slot = a.slot AND s.type = a.station_name
GROUP BY t.slot
ORDER BY time ASC;

panels.description:
Station availability (%) over an 8-hour shift. 
Downtime is triggered by any data gap longer than 2 minutes. 
Formula: 100 * (1 - Downtime Minutes / 480).

Note: This measures connection uptime and data-logging stability. A station waiting idly for materials but actively reporting data counts as available. A station running perfectly during a network drop counts as downtime.

targets.rawSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
readings AS (
    SELECT
        se.station_id,
        st.type AS station_type,
        hp.date,
        LAG(hp.date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY se.station_id ORDER BY hp.date
        ) AS prev_date
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
    JOIN gman_sinf22.station st ON st.station_id = se.station_id
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '8 hours'
),
downtime AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        station_type,
        SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date - prev_date)) / 60.0) FILTER (
            WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date - prev_date)) > 120
        ) AS downtime_min
    FROM readings
    GROUP BY station_id, station_type
)
SELECT
    station_type AS "Station",
    ROUND(
        100.0 * (1 - COALESCE(downtime_min, 0) / 480.0),
    2) AS "Availability (%)"
FROM downtime
ORDER BY "Availability (%)" ASC;

targets.rawSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
readings AS (
    SELECT
        se.station_id,
        st.type AS station_type,
        hp.date,
        LAG(hp.date) OVER (
            PARTITION BY se.station_id ORDER BY hp.date
        ) AS prev_date
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
    JOIN gman_sinf22.station st ON st.station_id = se.station_id
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '24 hours'
),
gaps AS (
    SELECT
        station_id,
        station_type,
        prev_date AS "Gap Start",
        date AS "Gap End",
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date - prev_date)) / 60.0 AS gap_minutes
    FROM readings
    WHERE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (date - prev_date)) > 120
)
SELECT
    station_id AS "Station ID",
    station_type AS "Station",
    COUNT(*) AS "Downtime Events",
    ROUND(SUM(gap_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Total Downtime (min)",
    ROUND(MAX(gap_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Longest Event (min)",
    TO_CHAR(MAX("Gap Start"), 'HH24:MI') AS "Last Event Start",
    TO_CHAR(MAX("Gap End"), 'HH24:MI') AS "Last Event End"
FROM gaps
GROUP BY station_id, station_type
ORDER BY "Total Downtime (min)" DESC NULLS LAST;

panels.description:
Risk Score (0-100) evaluates asset health by tracking deviations from normal historical baselines across temperature, vibration, and station availability metrics.

RISK LEVELS:

0 to 35 (Green): Low Risk. Normal operational behavior.

36 to 70 (Yellow): Medium Risk. Moderate baseline deviation; schedule maintenance.

71 to 100 (Red): High Risk. Critical anomaly or severe asset stress; immediate action required.

targets.rawSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
vibration AS (
    SELECT
        se.station_id,
        AVG(hp.value) AS avg_vib,
        MAX(hp.value) AS max_vib
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE se.type = 'Vibration'
      AND hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '8 hours'
    GROUP BY se.station_id
),
temperature AS (
    SELECT
        se.station_id,
        AVG(hp.value) AS avg_temp,
        MAX(hp.value) AS max_temp
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE se.type = 'Temperature'
      AND hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '8 hours'
    GROUP BY se.station_id
),
anomalies AS (
    SELECT
        se.station_id,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE ABS(hp.value - avg_val) > (3 * std_val)
        ) AS anomaly_count,
        COUNT(*) AS total_readings
    FROM (
        SELECT
            hp.sensor_id,
            hp.value,
            AVG(hp.value) OVER (PARTITION BY hp.sensor_id) AS avg_val,
            STDDEV(hp.value) OVER (PARTITION BY hp.sensor_id) AS std_val
        FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
        CROSS JOIN max_date md
        WHERE hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '8 hours'
    ) hp
    JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
    GROUP BY se.station_id
)
SELECT
    st.type AS station_name,
    COALESCE(ROUND(v.avg_vib::numeric, 3), 0) AS avg_vibration,
    COALESCE(ROUND(t.max_temp::numeric, 1), 0) AS peak_temp,
    COALESCE(ROUND(100.0 * a.anomaly_count / NULLIF(a.total_readings, 0), 2), 0) AS anomaly_rate,
    COALESCE(ROUND((
        LEAST(v.avg_vib / 5.0, 1.0) * 40 +
        LEAST(GREATEST(t.max_temp - 303.0, 0) / 50.0, 1.0) * 40 +
        LEAST(100.0 * a.anomaly_count / NULLIF(a.total_readings, 0) / 20.0, 1.0) * 20
    )::numeric, 1), 0) AS risk_score
FROM gman_sinf22.station st
LEFT JOIN vibration v ON v.station_id = st.station_id
LEFT JOIN temperature t ON t.station_id = st.station_id
LEFT JOIN anomalies a ON a.station_id = st.station_id
ORDER BY risk_score DESC NULLS LAST;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
)
SELECT
    TO_TIMESTAMP(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM hp.date) / 1800) * 1800) AS time,
    st.type AS "metric",
    ROUND(AVG(hp.value)::numeric, 3) AS "value"
FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
JOIN gman_sinf22.sensor se ON se.sensor_id = hp.sensor_id
JOIN gman_sinf22.station st ON st.station_id = se.station_id
CROSS JOIN max_date md
WHERE se.type = 'Vibration'
  AND hp.date >= md.last_now - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM hp.date) / 1800), st.station_id, st.type
ORDER BY time ASC;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
)
SELECT
    TO_TIMESTAMP(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 1800) * 1800) AS time,
    ROUND(AVG(value)::numeric, 2) AS "Avg Processing Force (N)",
    ROUND(MAX(value)::numeric, 2) AS "Peak Force (N)"
FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
CROSS JOIN max_date
WHERE sensor_id = 15
  AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 1800)
ORDER BY time ASC;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
)
SELECT
    TO_TIMESTAMP(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 3600) * 3600) AS time,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS "OK Parts",
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value NOT BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS "Reprocessed Parts",
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value NOT BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2) AS "Reprocess Rate (%)"
FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
CROSS JOIN max_date
WHERE sensor_id = 16
  AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 3600)
ORDER BY time ASC;

WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
reprocess_ratio AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE value NOT BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS failure_rate
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id = 16
      AND date >= DATE_TRUNC('day', last_now) - INTERVAL '7 days'
),
energy_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(hp.value) AS avg_kw,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(hp.date) - MIN(hp.date))) / 3600.0 AS total_hours
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production hp
    CROSS JOIN max_date md
    WHERE hp.sensor_id = 34
      AND hp.date >= DATE_TRUNC('day', md.last_now) - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT
    ROUND((em.avg_kw * em.total_hours * rr.failure_rate * 2)::numeric, 2) AS "Wasted Energy on Reprocessing",
    ROUND((em.avg_kw * em.total_hours * rr.failure_rate * 2 * 0.1380)::numeric, 2) AS "Financial Loss from Rework"
FROM energy_metrics em
CROSS JOIN reprocess_ratio rr;

panels.description: This correlation represents an operational hypothesis based on physical sensor proximity along the production line, not an explicitly confirmed causal relationship.

targets.rawSql:
WITH max_date AS (
    SELECT MAX(date) AS last_now FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
),
humidity AS (
    SELECT
        TO_TIMESTAMP(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 3600) * 3600) AS hour,
        AVG(value) AS avg_humidity
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id = 12
      AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 3600)
),
line_performance AS (
    SELECT
        TO_TIMESTAMP(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 3600) * 3600) AS hour,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 8) AS total_s2,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 8 AND value = 0) AS ok_s2,
        
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 17) AS total_s3,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 17 AND value = 0) AS ok_s3,
        
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 16) AS total_dim,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sensor_id = 16 AND value BETWEEN 0.01 AND 0.1) AS ok_dim
    FROM gman_sinf22.historical_production
    CROSS JOIN max_date
    WHERE sensor_id IN (8, 17, 16)
      AND date >= last_now - INTERVAL '24 hours'
    GROUP BY FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM date) / 3600)
)
SELECT
    h.hour AS time,
    ROUND(h.avg_humidity::numeric, 2) AS "Wood Humidity (g/m³)",
    ROUND(100.0 * (COALESCE(lp.ok_s2, 0) + COALESCE(lp.ok_s3, 0) + COALESCE(lp.ok_dim, 0)) / 
          NULLIF(COALESCE(lp.total_s2, 0) + COALESCE(lp.total_s3, 0) + COALESCE(lp.total_dim, 0), 0), 2) AS "System Quality Yield (%)"
FROM humidity h
LEFT JOIN line_performance lp ON lp.hour = h.hour
ORDER BY time ASC;
